title: Counting Together
summary: Kau asks his mother for mangoes to share with his friends at school. How many mangoes does he want? A counting book up to 9.
pages: Kau gets his things ready for school.
Before he leaves for school, he asks Mom for mangoes.
Mom asks: "How many mangoes do you want?"
Mom tells Kau to take the 9 mangoes.
Kau's big sister gets ready to take him to school.
Kau's big sister walks down the stairs with him. 9 steps on the way to school.
When they get to school, Kau goes into the classroom.
Kau counts the mangoes together with his friends: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9.
Each of the friends eats one mango.
